headline: Andavi Solutions Acquires Infilect to Expand AI Retail Capabilities
summary: Andavi Solutions has acquired Infilect to integrate image recognition and agentic AI into its existing salesforce automation platform. The merger aims to create a comprehensive AI-led solution for retail execution.
why: Andavi Solutions provides sales execution software for consumer goods companies, while Infilect specializes in computer vision technology for retail analytics. M&A activity in the AI sector reflects ongoing efforts to consolidate specialized software capabilities.

impacts.name: Andavi Solutions
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's product portfolio in the retail AI space.
